title: Kakino stone circle with magnetic anomalies from lightning

tellings.quote: this exact same thing at a site called Kakino where it's a tough hillside.

plain: At Kakino in Japan, a stone circle on a steep hillside is said to show the same magnetic oddities caused by lightning that are found at other ancient sites. Geoffrey Drumm, a researcher who says he has seen these sites, tells it without naming a source. He brings it up as a sign that ancient builders chose or used places where lightning left a mark on the rock.
